title: Kibera Primary School
summary: A six-classroom primary school built for 400 children who previously studied in a tin-roofed shed.
description: Kibera Primary School was built in partnership with the local community council after years of children studying in a single overcrowded room.
The finished building includes six classrooms, a library, and a covered assembly yard, and now serves over 400 students.

title: Mwanza Community Water Well
summary: A borehole well providing clean drinking water to over 1,200 residents across three villages.
description: Before this project, residents walked over 5km each day to collect water from a seasonal river.
The new borehole well, fitted with a solar-powered pump, now serves three neighboring villages year-round.

title: Lira Community Clinic
summary: A maternal health clinic under construction to serve a district with no prior access to prenatal care.
description: The Lira Community Clinic is currently under construction and will include a maternity ward, an outpatient wing, and staff housing.
Once complete, it will serve an estimated 15,000 residents across the surrounding district.

title: Accra Family Housing Initiative
summary: Twelve flood-resistant family homes built for households displaced by seasonal flooding.
description: Twelve families displaced by recurring seasonal flooding now have permanent, elevated, flood-resistant homes.
Each home was built with local labor, creating temporary employment for over 40 community members during construction.

title: Kampala Youth Community Center
summary: A multipurpose center offering vocational training, sports facilities, and a library for local youth.
description: The Kampala Youth Community Center gives young people in the area a safe space for vocational training and recreation.
The center now runs carpentry, tailoring, and computer literacy programs for over 200 youth annually.
